change: Append only five-session yield changes at 2y/5y/10y and twenty-session 2s10s slope change. Preserve original nine features, original labels, Ridge alpha and time split. No feature subset or hyperparameter search.
preprocessing: Previous-session cutoff; added-feature imputation means and Ridge scaling use fit rows only. Add missing flags. Original calibration and missing flags remain unchanged.
target: Reuse archived next-decision four-action net labels at benchmark openings. Fit only 2 lot; identical forecasts and actions at 1 lot.
split: Original 29 purged fit intervals per fold and original last-third inner holdout. Already viewed development periods, not independent confirmation.
controls: Original nine-feature Ridge, zero tilt, fit-label mean selected fixed action, and the fixed action selected on the original continuous fit ledger.
screen: At 2 lot beat both original Ridge and fit-mean RMSE in at least two folds; require positive three-fold median selected-label gains versus all four controls. At 1 lot require all median gains nonnegative. A pass permits a continuous replay on these inner development windows only; never PPO expansion or forward confirmation.
